title: Qualify validators before they gate completion
narrative: Taloneth starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Before a schema validator gates done, known-good, known-bad, and missing fixtures must run — including a weak always-pass mutant that must fail qualification. Judge scores alone cannot complete a task (see `fangore_refund_verdict`).
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.
